question: A and B are two stations 370 km apart. A train starts from station A at 9:00 A.M. and travels towards station B at a speed of 20 km/hr. Another train starts from station B at 10:00 A.M. and travels towards station A at a speed of 50 km per/ hr. At what time do they meet?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered by train A from 9:00 A.M. to 10:00 A.M. = 20 × 1 = 20 km.

Remaining distance between trains at 10:00 A.M. = 370 − 20 = 350 km.

Relative speed (opposite direction) = 20 + 50 = 70 km/hr.

Time to meet after 10:00 A.M. = 350 ÷ 70 = 5 hours.

Meeting time = 10:00 A.M. + 5 hours = 3:00 P.M.

**∴ The correct answer is 3:00 P.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance between station A and station B = 370 km

Speed of the train starting from A at 9:00 A.M. = 20 km/hr

Speed of the train starting from B at 10:00 A.M. = 50 km/hr
